title: Missing Number
constraints: All numbers in nums are unique.
Exactly one value from the inclusive range [0, n] is absent.

examples.explanation: n = 3. The range [0..3] has 4 numbers. Missing number is 2.
The range is [0,1], so the missing endpoint can be zero.

solutionApproaches.title: Boolean Presence Array
solutionApproaches.explanation: Mark each seen value and scan the full range, which is clear but uses extra memory.

solutionApproaches.title: Gauss Sum
solutionApproaches.explanation: Expected sum = n*(n+1)/2. Subtract actual sum to get the missing value.
